description: Excavation of basement and formation of front and rear lightwells, erection of single storey extension at lower ground floor level.
decision_conditions: Prior to the first use of the development hereby approved, the proposed planter located in the rear garden sited along the boundary with no. 163 Osbaldeston Road, as shown on the proposed drawings, shall be installed and retained thereafter.REASON: To safeguard the amenity of occupiers of neighbouring properties in particular to prevent overlooking.

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Detailed drawings/full particulars of the proposed development showing the matters set out below must be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, in writing, prior to superstructure works. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved which shall be implemented in full prior to the first occupation/use of the development.a) Details of new and replacement windows and doors, which shall include 1:20 elevations and 1:5 sections. Replacement windows shall have a glazing thickness no more than 14mm with timber frames and integrated glazing bars where appropriate.REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.

Prior to superstructure works, detailed specification, a drainage layout and a management & maintenance plan (where applicable) of at least one suitable sustainable drainage system (i.e. water butt with overflow, raingarden, bioretention planter box, living roof (substrate depth of 80-150mm excluding the vegetative mat), permeable paving etc.) shall be submitted to, and approved by the LPA, in consultation with the LLFA. If soakaways i.e. plastic modules and soakaway rings are used, an infiltration test must be carried out to ensure that the capacity of the soil is suitable for infiltration. It must be demonstrated that there will be no increase in surface water flow being discharged offsite and an overall reduction in peak flow rate and volume.REASON: To address adaptation to, and mitigation of, climate change; provide sustainable urban drainage and manage surface water run-off as close to source as possible; enhance biodiversity values; and improve the appearance and resilience of the development.

A scheme for the provision and implementation of flood resilient and resistant construction details and measures for the basement extension and lightwell against groundwater flood risk shall be submitted to and agreed, in writing with the LPA in consultation with the LLFA prior to the construction of the measures. The scheme shall be carried out in its entirety before the basement extension is occupied and constructed and completed in accordance with the approved plans in line with BS 8102:2022 Protection of below ground structures against water ingress - code of practice.REASON: To address and mitigate the impacts of flood risk.

Full details, with samples or product images and specification, of the materials to be used for the windows, glazing and doors, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing prior to superstructure works. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.
